summary: netif_hosttest.c, the socket calls' handlers, with 14 faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/syscall_net.c

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -g -O1 -ffreestanding -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/netif_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c tests/host/compat/kheap_host.c -o ${WORK}/netif_hosttest

faults.name: device-index
faults.summary: SO_BINDTODEVICE records interface 1, not the named device

lines: netif-test: fail: device index is two

faults.name: device-name
faults.summary: SO_BINDTODEVICE reads back the first interface name

lines: netif-test: fail: device name is eth1

faults.name: packet-index
faults.summary: a packet socket reports the first interface's index

faults.name: packet-mac
faults.summary: a packet socket reports the first interface's address

faults.name: tcp-address
faults.summary: a TCP endpoint reports the host's address, not its own

faults.name: accept
faults.summary: accept on a socket that is not a listening stream waits

lines: netif-test: fail: invalid accept never waits

faults.name: socket-check
faults.summary: socket takes a type bit other than SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK

lines: netif-test: fail: a type bit other than SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK is refused

faults.name: socket-flags
faults.summary: socket's SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK never reach the descriptor

lines: netif-test: fail: SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK reach the descriptor

faults.name: accept-check
faults.summary: accept4 takes a flag other than SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK

lines: netif-test: fail: accept4 refuses a flag other than SOCK_CLOEXEC and SOCK_NONBLOCK

faults.name: accept-flags
faults.summary: accept4's flags never reach the new descriptor

lines: netif-test: fail: a connection accepted with both flags has both

faults.name: accept-enomem
faults.summary: an accept the heap has no room for answers EMFILE

lines: netif-test: fail: an accept the heap has no room for is ENOMEM

faults.name: recvfrom-length
faults.summary: a recvfrom with an address and no length pointer is taken

lines: netif-test: fail: a recvfrom with an address and no length is EFAULT

faults.name: recvfrom-sender
faults.summary: a recvfrom with a length pointer is refused

lines: netif-test: fail: a recvfrom with a length pointer takes the datagram

faults.summary: the number accept reserves is published before the socket is ready

lines: netif-test: fail: another thread's close of the number accept reserved finds nothing
